ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Sects 2.0 (preview)
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
The great sects of Jiuxiao for Convergence: Era of Cultivation, rebuilt on Royalty. Development preview: not for play yet.
Each sect grants honorary titles to the colonists who earn its trust (Sect Friend, Honored Guest, Sect Protector, Guest Elder). Its currency is sect contribution, earned with its quests, and spent on favors: disciples who come to your aid, spirit resources and more. Your colony stays independent.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation, Royalty and Ideology. Do not use together with Convergence: Sects.
